# SpaceDev — Full Reference

> Blockchain development company offering Web3 engineering, traditional software development, IT staff augmentation, and blockchain security auditing. Founded 8 years ago; 70+ team members across USA, Uruguay, Argentina and Colombia; 200+ projects delivered; 50+ five-star Clutch reviews. This file is the extended companion to https://spacedev.io/llms.txt

## Core services in detail

### Blockchain Development Services (https://spacedev.io/blockchain-development-services)
End-to-end blockchain development from concept to mainnet: DeFi platforms, dApps, NFT marketplaces, DAOs, smart contracts, cryptocurrencies, white-label crypto exchanges. Ecosystems: Ethereum and EVM chains (Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism), Solana, Aptos, Hedera, Cosmos. Languages: Solidity, Rust, Move. Tooling: Foundry, Hardhat, OpenZeppelin, The Graph.

Specializations:
- Smart Contract Development (https://spacedev.io/blockchain-development-services/smart-contract-development)
- dApp Development (https://spacedev.io/blockchain-development-services/dapp-development)
- Asset Tokenization (https://spacedev.io/blockchain-development-services/asset-tokenization) including Real Estate Tokenization (https://spacedev.io/blockchain-development-services/asset-tokenization/real-estate)
- Blockchain for Banks (https://spacedev.io/blockchain-development-services/blockchain-for-banks)
- White-Label Blockchain Partner for agencies (https://spacedev.io/blockchain-development-services/blockchain-partner)
- Decentralized Identity / DID (https://spacedev.io/blockchain-development-services/decentralized-identity)
- Layer 1 Blockchain Development with Cosmos SDK, Substrate, EVM chains, Avalanche subnets (https://spacedev.io/blockchain-development-services/layer-1-blockchain-development)

Industry solutions:
- Finance & Fintech: DeFi protocols, smart contracts, tokenized financial infrastructure (https://spacedev.io/blockchain-development-services/industry/finance-and-fintech)
- Stablecoin Development: fiat-backed, crypto-collateralized and hybrid (https://spacedev.io/blockchain-development-services/industry/finance-and-fintech/stablecoins)
- Healthcare: HIPAA-aligned records, claims automation, pharma tracking (https://spacedev.io/blockchain-development-services/industry/healthcare)
- Energy: trading platforms, REC tokenization, carbon credits (https://spacedev.io/blockchain-development-services/industry/energy)
- Supply Chain & Logistics: traceability, freight payment automation, provenance (https://spacedev.io/blockchain-development-services/industry/supply-chain-and-logistics)

### Web & Mobile Solutions (https://spacedev.io/innovative-web-and-mobile-solutions)
Custom software, web and mobile app development engineered for scale. Stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Go, React Native, Flutter, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, GCP, Vercel. Ships both React Native and native iOS/Android.

### IT Staff Augmentation (https://spacedev.io/staff-augmentation)
Pre-vetted nearshore developers, designers and specialists from Latin America, ready in under 2 weeks. US-overlapping time zones. Process: 1) Identify Your Needs → 2) Candidate Screening → 3) Welcome Aboard → 4) Management & Scaling. Typical rates for staff augmentation: $60–120/hr depending on role and seniority.

### Product Discovery (https://spacedev.io/product-discovery)
Strategy sprints, MVP definition, brand strategy, go-to-market planning, continuous discovery. A structured 1–4 week engagement that validates the business case, defines scope, designs UX, selects the tech stack and produces a prioritized, build-ready roadmap before writing production code.

### BlockAudit (https://spacedev.io/blockaudit-smart-contract-and-blockchain-security)
Smart contract audit and blockchain security: static and manual analysis, formal verification, post-launch monitoring. Detects vulnerabilities before deployment.

## Engagement models

1. **MVP Builder** — for clients needing to launch a top-quality MVP fast: Discovery Phase → Proposal Phase → MVP Build → Product Growth and Support.
2. **IT Staff Augmentation** — flexible IT talent without permanent commitments: Identify Your Needs → Candidate Screening → Welcome Aboard → Management & Scaling.

## Frequently asked questions

**Do you offer free consultation?** Yes — a free 45-minute consultation to understand your needs and how we can support your project.

**What are your rates?** Time & materials, fixed-scope, and dedicated-team pricing. Most staff augmentation engagements land in the $60–120/hr range; project pricing depends on scope.

**What services do you offer?** Five core services: Blockchain Development, Web & Mobile Development, IT Staff Augmentation, Product Discovery, and BlockAudit (smart contract security).

**What is an MVP?** The smallest version of your product that delivers real value to a real user — a shippable product designed to learn from market feedback as fast and cheaply as possible.

**Staff Augmentation vs. Development Services?** Staff Augmentation embeds engineers into your team and processes — you manage the work. Development Services means SpaceDev owns the project end-to-end: discovery, design, build, ship, support.

## Case studies (https://spacedev.io/our-work)

- NDAX Canada (https://spacedev.io/our-work/ndax-canada): Frontend and React Native app for Canada's most prominent crypto exchange, with AlphaPoint banking integration; quadrupled signups, verification rate lifted to 80%.
- Drata (https://spacedev.io/our-work/drata): 4+ year partnership rebuilding the cross-platform compliance Agent and Audit Hub for automated security compliance.
- Rarible (https://spacedev.io/our-work/rarible): NFT marketplace development.
- ApeBond (https://spacedev.io/our-work/apebond): On-chain OTC marketplace expanded to Solana — Rust program, TypeScript SDK, cross-chain DeFi frontend.
- Bondi Finance (https://spacedev.io/our-work/bondi-finance): KYC-gated bond tokenization smart contract infrastructure with USDC funding and NFT rewards.
- Blockus (https://spacedev.io/our-work/blockus): Web3 gaming platform — NFT management API, instant wallets, gasless transactions, Stripe payments.
- FightFI (https://spacedev.io/our-work/fightfi): Gamified Web3 platform on Aptos with NFT rewards and real-time fan leaderboards.
- Aura (https://spacedev.io/our-work/aura): Fintech mobile app for gold-backed savings powered by Tether's XAUT, discovery to production in 5.5 months.
- Zenda (https://spacedev.io/our-work/zenda): Uruguayan crypto exchange for USDT with KYC, non-custodial wallets, RedPagos and MercadoPago payments.
- ACME (https://spacedev.io/our-work/acme): Multi-chain Web3 loyalty platform with one-tap crypto payments.
- Gallery (https://spacedev.io/our-work/gallery): NFT art platform — Solidity contracts, NestJS API, React frontend — delivered in five months.
- PiggyGPT (https://spacedev.io/our-work/piggygpt): AI-powered DeFi trading assistant for the EVM ecosystem with Telegram trading and cross-chain swaps.
- W3E (https://spacedev.io/our-work/w3e): Web3 gaming launchpad — cross-chain smart contracts, IDO/INO flows, staking.
- Blockchain for Energy (https://spacedev.io/our-work/blockchain-for-energy): Consortium platform for the energy sector.
- AthleteAI (https://spacedev.io/our-work/athleteai): iOS sports highlights app — React Native video capture and Mux streaming — built in four months.
- Genba (https://spacedev.io/our-work/genba): Factory palletizing automation platform built in two months after a discovery sprint.
- iAffirm (https://spacedev.io/our-work/iaffirm): AI mental wellness web app — personalized affirmations and guided meditations.
- Nomei (https://spacedev.io/our-work/nomei): AI coaching platform with long-term memory and emotional analytics.
- Ubicuity (https://spacedev.io/our-work/ubicuity): Figma-like visual designer and React Native app for interactive digital spaces.
- Mostaza, NGA, Glowy Music, Twispi, Byrrgis: additional Web2/Web3 product engineering case studies.
